name: done
description: Finish the task and return a summary to the user. Setting `success: true` marks the task as completed; `false` marks it as aborted (e.g. blocked by a paywall, login wall, or unrecoverable error). The text is shown verbatim to the user — keep it one sentence and concrete (the answer, not 'I clicked some things').

inputs.name: success
inputs.description: True if the task completed successfully; false if it had to be abandoned.

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: Required one-sentence answer or status. Shown verbatim to the user.

input_examples.text: Found X: <one-sentence answer with the concrete result>.
Couldn't sign in — login form requires a 2FA code I don't have access to.
